 02. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. This matter is listed in the Special Cause List prepared for the purpose of Special Mediation Drive-Mediation 'For the Nation'.
3.

Mr. Baral, learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that the writ petition has been filed to refer the matter to the Authority under Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the meantime, the matter has already been referred to the Authority.
Thus, the matter has become infructuous.
Hence, he prays for withdrawal of the writ petition.
4. He files a memo in support of his submission, which is taken on record.
5. Accordingly, this writ petition stands disposed of as withdrawn.

(K.R. Mohapatra)
